catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: Products, service items, and spare parts are tagged with a product category so later job forms can filter them.
catalog.noProductsBody: Add products sold at RIZO market so sales can attach warranty cover.

catalog.categoryHint: Services and spare parts will be tagged to this same category.

customers.title: Customers
customers.intro: Search by name or phone, then open a full purchase and service history.
customers.emptyBody: Add a customer to start recording sales and service jobs.
customers.passwordShare: Share this temporary password with the customer. It will not be shown again.
customers.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed if they have no sales or service history.

sales.title: Sales
sales.intro: Each sale stores warranty months and an expiry date used on later service jobs.
sales.emptyBody: Record a market purchase so warranty status is calculated automatically.
sales.deleteBody: Invoice {{invoice}} will be removed if it is not linked to a service request.
sales.invoiceHint: Leave blank to auto-assign the next RZ number.

requests.emptyBody: Create a job from a customer sale or as a new RIZO Service request.

kanban.title: Dispatch board
kanban.intro: Drag a card to change status. Columns follow each service type flow.

tech.title: My jobs
tech.intro: Swipe columns. Hold a card to drag it, or use the buttons.
tech.pauseHoursHint: Required. The countdown starts when you pause.
tech.pauseReasonHint: Required. This is stored on the pause record.
tech.pauseReasonPlaceholder: Waiting for a spare part, customer not home…
tech.pauseHint: Set how long {{name}}'s job should stay paused, and why.

job.timelineHint: Pauses, start, and completion stay on this job.
job.noParts: No spare parts in this category.
job.noPhotos: No photos yet. Completion is blocked until you add at least one.
job.photosHint: Required · add several at once from the camera or gallery
job.partsHint: Required · tap to add, then set quantity
job.notFoundBody: This job is not assigned to you.

receipt.title: Receipts
receipt.intro: Print a branded receipt after a job is completed, closed, or replaced.
receipt.emptyBody: Receipts appear here when a request is finished.
receipt.thanks: Thank you for choosing RIZO Service.
receipt.notFoundBody: This request is missing or you do not have access.
receipt.disclaimerDefault: Unclaimed products, accessories, and spare parts left at RIZO Service for more than 14 days after this receipt date may be disposed of or used for parts. Please keep this receipt as proof of service. RIZO Service is not responsible for customer data left on devices.
receipt.emptyLines: No service lines, parts, or extras recorded yet.
receipt.disclaimerHint: Shown at the bottom of the printed receipt. Edit freely before you print.
receipt.searchPlaceholder: Search customer, product, technician, or ID

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Workload, resolution time, defects, revenue, and technician ratings.
reports.hubIntro: Admin-only analytics. Each report uses the same date range and can be exported as CSV for Excel.
reports.revenueHint: Revenue is the final cost of completed paid jobs. In-warranty free repairs are not counted as revenue.
reports.defectsHint: Defect mix is taken from repair requests in this period.
reports.emptyBody: Widen the date range or wait until new jobs are created.
reports.loadFailedBody: Try again in a moment. Figures refresh when jobs change.
reports.noCompleted: No completed jobs in this period

nav.productsBody: Request volume, installation vs repair, paid revenue, and warranty ratio for each product.
nav.partsBody: Quantity used, parts revenue, and most frequent parts. Filter by product.
nav.expensesBody: Additional expenses and parts cost, broken down by technician and product.
nav.profitBody: Paid repair revenue minus parts and extra expenses, with a daily, weekly, or monthly trend.
nav.techniciansBody: Completed jobs, average resolution time, customer rating, and revenue per technician.
nav.warrantyBody: Count and value of in-warranty (free) vs out-of-warranty (paid) jobs over time.
nav.sourcesBody: Requests from RIZO market versus jobs opened in RIZO Service or the customer portal.
